subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should this fix cover only new QMD search results, or must the same release also repair or discard already-stored contaminated short-term recall state?
rationale: Leaving stored state untouched allows the reported downstream Dreaming contamination to persist after upgrade, while repairing it changes persistent memory behavior and requires an explicit ownership and migration policy.

options.title: Adapter-Only Fix
options.body: Merge the focused adapter change and explicitly treat historical short-term recalls as rebuildable or naturally expiring state.

options.title: Doctor Cleanup
options.body: Add a narrow doctor-owned migration that verifies and removes or repairs only affected QMD-contaminated recall records.

options.title: Track Cleanup Separately
options.body: Land the new-result fix while keeping a narrower canonical issue open for historical-state policy and implementation.

recommendation.title: Adapter-Only Fix
recommendation.body: Merge the focused adapter change and explicitly treat historical short-term recalls as rebuildable or naturally expiring state.
